newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Semapa hits high, tracks Cimpor.
newsitem.headline: Semapa hits high, tracks Cimpor.

text.p: Shares in Portuguese cement holding Semapa hit a new high for 1996 of 2,165 escudos, supported by the recent rise in rival cement firm Cimpor-Cimentos de Portugal, dealers said.
"The activity in Semapa is related to Cimpor due to Cimpor's imminent privatisation and its profit from the sale of its stake in Banco de Fomento e Exterior," said an analyst.
He added: "Cimpor is leading the way with Semapa following."
Semapa eased to 2,160 escudos, up 30, on a volume of 46,100 shares at 1030 GMT. Cimpor stood at 3,440 escudos, up 13, in volume of 43,270 shares.
Cimpor and Semapa between them control all cement production in Portugal.
